Employer guide checklist item used '{FACTS.liveSessions} 个指定周末' (bound the session count to 'weekend'), which misstates the schedule for the four cohorts that run Friday–Saturday, not Saturday–Sunday (zh-register-audit.json high-confidence issues #1 and #16).

problemsFound.problem: H2 '{FACTS.durationMonths} 个月，完整课程。' carried a trailing period; the certificate sentence in the same section rendered 'CMI Certificate of Recognition' without the Chinese term (获颁 CMI Certificate of Recognition), against the glossary rule that the certificate is named 'CMI 认可证书（CMI Certificate of Recognition）' and against the canonical wording already used in content-zh.ts.
problemsFound.fix: Removed the trailing period and changed the certificate sentence to '将获颁 CMI 认可证书（CMI Certificate of Recognition）', matching the canonical rendering used elsewhere on the site.

problemsFound.problem: The section 04 heading rendered the raw English string CERTIFICATE_POSITIONING.headline ('Awarded and endorsed by CMI · professional development') on a Chinese page — no Chinese heading. The body also named the certificate without the Chinese gloss and used an ad hoc boundary sentence instead of the canonical professionalRelevance sentence, so the not-an-MQA-degree boundary was not guaranteed to be in the same viewport as the CMI claim.
problemsFound.fix: Replaced the heading with a Chinese heading '由 CMI 颁发并认可 · 专业发展' (matches owner decision 2026-09-10 §14.1 wording 'issued and recognised by CMI'), fixed the certificate sentence to include the Chinese gloss, and replaced the ad hoc boundary text with CERTIFICATE_POSITIONING_PROFESSIONAL_RELEVANCE_ZH imported from content-zh.ts, so the canonical no-guarantee sentence renders in the same block. Removed the now-unused CERTIFICATE_POSITIONING import.

problemsFound.problem: H2 '标准费用与奖学金资格。' carried a trailing period; the scholarship sentence ended '并非自动获得' instead of the canonical '并非自动授予' used by every other scholarship sentence on the site.
problemsFound.fix: Removed the trailing period and changed '并非自动获得' to '并非自动授予'.

problemsFound.problem: H2 '报名之前，先确认这些问题。' carried a trailing period and used 报名 (enrol) rather than the site's controlled enrolment-adjacent verb.
problemsFound.fix: Reworded to '报读之前，先确认这些问题' (no trailing period; 报读 matches the glossary's preferred verb for enrolling on a course).
